message: どうしてついてくる!?

name: Synn
message: 「Guess they're not here~」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm?」

name: Misa
message: 「Mmmgh...」

name: Synn
message: 「What's wrong?」

name: Misa
message: 「Why are you following me around?!」

name: Synn
message: 「You're on patrol, right?」

name: Misa
message: 「No, I am not.」

name: Synn
message: 「Slacking off, then?」

name: Misa
message: 「No!」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm kidding. So, what are you doing?」

name: Misa
message: 「As if I'd tell you!」

name: Synn
message: 「Mean...」

name: Misa
message: 「Besides, you... you're just following me because you want to see me transform anyway, aren't you?」

name: Synn
message: 「No way!! That's a huge misunderstanding. Completely out of the question.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Don't get so frustrated just cause your naked body isn't even worth looking at.」

name: Misa
message: 「Wh--?! I am not frustrated!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh, talk about self-absorbed.」

name: Misa
message: 「Ghh... And you look so cute on the outside, too...」
Biting her lip, she stomps away. Her short strides grow wider and wider until finally--

name: Synn
message: 「Ah!」
She dashes off in style.

name: Synn
message: 「Wait up, Misa!」
I tried to chase after her, but...

name: Paqy
message: 「To think she'd duck into the girls' room.」

name: Synn
message: 「She must've really needed to go...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kukuku... Distorting reality to interpret everything in the best possible light. As expected of the Demon Lord.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Was she not going to the bathroom?」

name: Paqy
message: 「You sure live a happy life, my Lord.」
Since waiting outside would be insensitive, I decided to wander around the school campus.

name: Synn
message: 「Where are these Demons supposed to be anyway?」

name: Paqy
message: 「When divine revelation hits, you'll just know.」

name: Synn
message: 「What does that even mean?」

name: Paqy
message: 「If I knew, we wouldn't be having such a hard time.」

name: Synn
message: 「You're pretty useless for a familiar...」
As I wandered around in exasperation, the library came into view.

name: Synn
message: 「I get it. If we don't know, we should look it up.」

name: Synn
message: 「Excuse me, do you have any books on Demons?」
I figured it couldn't hurt to ask the library committee member.

name: Tennouji-san
message: 「Yeah, we do~」

name: Synn
message: 「You actually do?!」

name: Tennouji-san
message: 「Is this a trend in the Student Council right now? The vice president borrowed one just a little while ago.」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa did?」

name: Tennouji-san
message: 「Look, over there.」
Following where the library committee member pointed, my eyes landed on Misa, intently engrossed in her reading.
Come to think of it, she was reading a book when I saw her before, too. She must really like reading.

name: Tennouji-san
message: 「She usually only borrows novels, though.」

name: Synn
message: 「Is that so?」
She seems like the type to read pure literature. But today, she's studying up on Demons.
I can't let myself fall behind either.

name: Synn
message: 「We shouldn't disturb them, so let's get going.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Are you sure you don't need to read it, Demon Lord?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. I'm gonna go to the bathroom too.」

name: Paqy
message: 「I told you, it's not a toilet...」
